# scripts/ops/Connect-AvdJumpbox.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Gets the operator jumpbox ready to connect to through Azure Bastion Developer, or stops it (build/decisions/0018-jumpbox-bastion-developer.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-NamePrefix` | string | yes |  |  |
| `-Environment` | string | yes |  |  |
| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  |  |
| `-Stop` | switch | no |  | Deallocate the jumpbox instead of preparing a connection. |
